name: Saikin no Nichijouteki Fukashigi - Monday Loop
original_name: 最近の日常的不可思議 Monday Loop
source:
A story about a freelance writer-type woman who gets caught up with high schoolers insisting they're "trapped in the same day, looping over and over," as she alternates between getting way too deep into it and just watching from the sidelines.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6909]novelgame[/url]]
translation:
一个关于一位自由作家型女性的故事，她陷入了高中生的困境，坚称她们“被困在同一天，一遍又一遍地循环”，她时而陷得太深，时而袖手旁观。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6909]novelgame[/url]]
